nodes.summary: There exists an oriented smooth knot $K$ in $\mathbb{R}^3$ that is chiral: it is not ambient-isotopic, as an oriented knot, to its mirror image $r \circ K$, where $r(x, y, z) = (x, y, -z)$ is the reflection through the $xy$-plane.
nodes.title: Existence of a chiral knot

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 1$ be an integer, let $F_i$ be the Fibonacci numbers ($F_0 = 0$, $F_1 = 1$), let $C_j = \sum_{i=1}^{j} (-1)^{i+1} F_i$ for $j \ge 0$, and let $M$ be the $3 \times 3$ integer matrix with rows $(2, -1, 0)$, $(0, 0, 1)$ and $(-1, 0, 2)$. nodes.title: Oesper's determinant formula for three-strand weaving knots
